style_lock: Premium painted comic / Amar Chitra; cream-saffron-gold cartouche; Ep 10 field-master density; Ep 09/10 is palette/costume language only — princes are gurukul YOUTHS, not battle-aged Ep 09/10 adults
camera: Heroic medium — named cast fills the frame, distant ranks only in the background
frame: Carved gold-and-lotus cartouche integrated into the painting (Ep 10 field-master / Ep 09 counsel) — not a thin rectangular sticker on a cream mat
prompt_prefix: Premium Amar Chitra / painted-comic illustration, native 3:2 canvas at least 1536×1024. Carved gold-and-lotus cartouche frame integrated into the artwork (not a thin sticker border, not a cream mat with four corner lotuses). Heroic medium shot: named figures fill the frame with engraved armor, refined linework, cream-saffron-gold hour. Not photoreal, not 16:9, not tiny distant heroes.

source_block.parva: Ādi Parva · Sambhava · Drona's bhāsa-lakṣya test
source_block.divergence: BORI CE places the bird-target in Ādi 1.123 (with Ekalavya in the same adhyāya). Gita Press Gorakhpur numbers the same event Ādi adhyāya 133. Ganguli’s vulgate English is Sambhava Sections CXXXIV–CXXXV. The trial itself agrees: artisan’s bird on a tree; Yudhishthira sees tree/guru/brothers/bird; Arjuna sees only the bird, then only its head; Drona says shoot.
source_block.chosen: Gita Press Gorakhpur + BORI overlap: the bhāsa-lakṣya trial as told in both. Debroy Vol. 1 translates BORI 1.123.
source_block.notes: Not TV. Not a living-bird hunt. Artificial bird (bhāsa) as target. No Krishna on this field.

drona.face: Aged acharya-warrior, noble lined face, long white beard and mustache (guru in the garden, not a garden sage only)
drona.hair: White hair in a saffron-bound topknot, rudraksha — no Kuru silver diadem of Bhishma
drona.costume: Saffron angavastram over pale cream dhoti, staff or bow of the guru

arjuna.face: Gurukul youth, teenage Pandava prince, slighter than Drona, smooth young face, light youthful mustache or none — NOT the battle-aged Ep 09 adult
arjuna.hair: Dark hair, simple gold youth-circlet (not a heavy battle mukut)
arjuna.costume: Cream-white dhoti, gold belt, quiver — never flower garland, never peacock, never gold cuirass

yudhishthira.face: Gurukul youth, eldest boy-prince, calm young face, modest or no mustache — distinct from Arjuna, NOT an adult king, not battle-aged
yudhishthira.hair: Dark hair, simple gold diadem, no peacock
yudhishthira.costume: Cream-white dhoti, gold sash, no Gandiva, no flower garland

armies.face: Fellow gurukul youths, distant, shorter than Drona
armies.costume: Muted banners, equal human scale, no gore
